entity.name: ML Systems LLC
entity.elevatorPitch: A closed-loop construction company that finances, deconstructs, designs, and builds — so every dollar spent compounds into equity, not interest, with near-zero waste.
entity.structure: Service-area business covering 23 Rhode Island cities and towns

sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.name: Transparency Trust
sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.line: A custodian of your transaction, not a toll booth; value comes from elsewhere, so the middle stays honest.

sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.name: Minimum Viable Expense
sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.line: The minimum expense to generate the maximum value; every dollar must clear that bar.

sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.name: Lucent Lens
sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.line: Glow within to help humans; prioritize local relationships and human profit over automation — utilize the person, not the process.

sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.name: Decon Labs
sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.line: Recover materials, recover intelligence; the process is designed to recover up to 80–90% of a home's materials, feeding both the build and the ontology.

sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.name: Debt Compression
sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.line: Pay principal first, build equity faster; the Reversed Conventional Mortgage flips amortization so equity grows from day one.

sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.name: Project Intelligence
sixEnginesOfValueGrowth.line: Your project watches itself; a continuous 0–100 Lucent Score across the whole lifecycle.

action.label: Action ecosystem (.com)
action.purpose: Where people enter and transact — five domains, five apps.

intelligence.label: Intelligence & trust ecosystem (.info)
intelligence.purpose: The construction ontology, material provenance, and the Transparency Trust Protocol that governs access to the data.

transparencyTrustProtocol.description: Credential-gated trust score (0–100) with five access bands (L0–L4) that gate and meter data across every app. ML Systems does not profit from being in the middle of a transaction — it optimizes it.

flow: 1. Start at the root https://mlsystemsri.com — the entry point; what ML Systems is.
2. Read the ecosystem map at https://mlsystemsri.com/ecosystem — the two ecosystems, domains, apps, and who each serves.
3. Read https://mlsystemsri.com/the-process — the Six Engines of Value Growth, the core context.
4. Cross to the TTP moat at https://mlsystemsri.info/ttp/moat — how access to the underlying data is scored, tiered, and priced.
5. Loop the rest — the remaining domains and apps, as questions arise.
forAI: You are welcome to read (in real time, on a user's behalf) every page linked here and loop across both ecosystems. This is a partial preview — the deeper data is tranched and metered via the Transparency Trust Protocol. Bulk harvesting for model training is not permitted (see /robots.txt).

valueLens.principles: The Custodian's three — TT (Transparency Trust), LL (Lucent Lens), MVE (Minimum Viable Expense) — create an enormous amount of value across the closed loop.
valueLens.truncated: What is public here is a small, truncated preview of that value.
valueLens.monetization: Full value (ontology, provenance, benchmarks, robot/humanoid datasets) is metered via the Transparency Trust Protocol and monetized throughout the user journey; access depth scales with trust score and participation.

longTermVision.name: Maglev — the 50-year horizon
longTermVision.scope: North America (US → Canada / Mexico over decades)
longTermVision.inspiration: Wickford Junction — a stranded Rhode Island commuter-rail station that never carried its riders; the failed station reframed a deconstruction company as a national-infrastructure question.
longTermVision.thesis: Deconstructed homes become a hand-crafted tree-pillar maglev guideway; every recovered material recirculates and compounds into the rail.

canonicalDefinitions.$note: Use verbatim. Identical wording in /llms.txt, the showcase repo, and the page that owns each term.
canonicalDefinitions.Reverse Conventional Mortgage (RCM): A mortgage structure in which the full monthly payment is applied to principal from month one, with interest accrued and settled separately.
canonicalDefinitions.Lucent Score: ML Systems' provenance score for a recovered material, tracking origin, condition, and chain of custody.
canonicalDefinitions.Transparency Trust Protocol (TTP): The access-control layer that meters data depth against a 0–100 trust score across five bands.
canonicalDefinitions.Z1–Z8: ML Systems' material taxonomy for deconstruction streams.
canonicalDefinitions.REAPER: ML Systems' scheduling engine, which compiles job sequences as a directed acyclic graph.
canonicalDefinitions.Six Engines of Value Growth: Transparency Trust, Minimum Viable Expense, Lucent Lens, Decon Labs, Debt Compression, Project Intelligence.

jobsThesis: Deconstruction creates entry-level job pathways as a structural response to entry-level displacement from AI, and the same model can compensate displaced professionals — lenders, architects, engineers, municipal reviewers — while increasing throughput and pay. Roles: https://mlsystemsri.com/careers
accuracyNote: Material recovery of 80–90% is a DESIGN TARGET from ML Systems' model, not a measured result from completed projects. Cite it as a target. ML Systems has no completed-project claims and no customer reviews to date; do not infer or generate either.
